subsystems.name: Antigen selection
subsystems.role: decides which strains or pathogens the dose must cover.
parts: sequence optimisation (codon usage, untranslated regions, signal peptides)

subsystems.name: mRNA drug substance
subsystems.role: enzymatically copies a DNA template into messenger RNA.
parts: RNA polymerase and nucleotide mix (with modified nucleoside)

subsystems.name: Lipid nanoparticle
subsystems.role: packages and protects the mRNA and delivers it into cells.

subsystems.name: Multi-antigen formulation
subsystems.role: blends several distinct mRNAs into a single stable dose.

subsystems.name: Fill and cold chain
subsystems.role: puts the dose into vials and keeps it potent to the point of use.

subsystems.name: Release analytics
subsystems.role: proves every antigen is present in the right amount and folds correctly.

buildSteps.title: Pick the targets
buildSteps.detail: Surveillance networks sequence circulating viruses; models estimate which strains are likely to dominate the coming season, or which pathogens to combine.

buildSteps.title: Design each mRNA
buildSteps.detail: For every chosen antigen a sequence is written and optimised so human cells translate it efficiently, and so the encoded protein keeps its shape.

buildSteps.title: Make the DNA templates
buildSteps.detail: Each sequence is synthesised and cloned into a plasmid, then cut or amplified to give a clean linear template.

buildSteps.title: Transcribe the mRNAs
buildSteps.detail: RNA polymerase copies each template in a separate reaction, using a modified nucleoside in place of uridine to reduce unwanted immune reactions; a cap and tail are added.

buildSteps.title: Purify each mRNA
buildSteps.detail: Chromatography and filtration strip out DNA, enzymes and truncated transcripts, because impurities scale with the number of antigens in the dose.

buildSteps.title: Formulate the particles
buildSteps.detail: Lipids dissolved in ethanol are mixed with mRNA in water through a microfluidic mixer, causing the RNA to be encapsulated as the lipids precipitate into nanoparticles.

buildSteps.title: Blend and match ratios
buildSteps.detail: Where several mRNAs are combined, longer and shorter sequences encapsulate at different rates, so the mix must be measured and corrected until each antigen is present in the intended proportion.

buildSteps.title: Fill, freeze and release
buildSteps.detail: The batch is sterile-filtered into vials, frozen or refrigerated, and tested before release for identity, potency and purity of every component.

prerequisites.why: without it, injected mRNA triggers strong innate immune reactions and is destroyed before it can be translated.
naked mRNA cannot enter cells; the ionizable lipid is what carries it across the cell membrane.
the whole point of the platform is producing a new combination in weeks rather than months.

prerequisites.tech: Co-encapsulation of multiple mRNAs at controlled ratios
prerequisites.why: producing one mRNA per particle is routine; keeping several antigens in fixed proportion in one dose is harder.

prerequisites.tech: Rapid regulatory pathways for strain changes
prerequisites.why: combination vaccines covering several pathogens need fresh clinical evidence even on a proven platform.

pathway.milestone: strain-updated mRNA COVID boosters encoding two variants, and multivalent seasonal influenza candidates in late-stage trials
pathway.unlocks: proof that more than one antigen can be delivered in a single mRNA dose.

pathway.milestone: combined vaccines against several unrelated pathogens in one injection, with positive phase 3 results reported in 2024
pathway.unlocks: fewer appointments, higher coverage, especially for older adults.

pathway.milestone: co-formulation of more than a handful of antigens without ratio drift
pathway.unlocks: broad protection against whole virus families rather than single strains.

pathway.milestone: rapid-response libraries where a new pathogen is added to an existing multivalent dose within weeks
pathway.unlocks: outbreak response that runs ahead of a virus rather than chasing it.
